author: EDM115 <npmjs@edm115.dev> (https://edm115.dev)
description: A CLI tool to generate hashes for the workspaces of your monorepo
name: monorepo-hash

scripts.build:bun: pnpm build:bun:linux-x64 && pnpm build:bun:linux-arm64 && pnpm build:bun:windows-x64 && pnpm build:bun:darwin-x64 && pnpm build:bun:darwin-arm64 && pnpm build:bun:linux-x64-musl && pnpm build:bun:linux-arm64-musl && pnpm build:bun:windows-arm64 && pnpm build:bun:chmod
scripts.build:bun:chmod: node -e "const { chmodSync } = require('fs'); const { readdirSync } = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const dir = path.join(__dirname, 'bun-build'); for (const file of readdirSync(dir)) { if (!file.includes('.')) { chmodSync(path.join(dir, file), 0o755); } }"
scripts.build:go: sh -c "targets='linux-x64 linux-arm64 windows-x64 darwin-x64 darwin-arm64 linux-x64-musl linux-arm64-musl windows-arm64'; for target in \$targets; do pnpm build:go:\$target; done" && pnpm build:go:chmod
scripts.build:go:chmod: node -e "const { chmodSync } = require('fs'); const { readdirSync } = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const dir = path.join(__dirname, 'go-build'); for (const file of readdirSync(dir)) { if (!file.includes('.')) { chmodSync(path.join(dir, file), 0o755); } }"
scripts.build:go:darwin-arm64: mkdir -p go-build && cd src/go && GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o ../../go-build/monorepo-hash-darwin-arm64 .
scripts.build:go:darwin-x64: mkdir -p go-build && cd src/go && GOOS=darwin GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o ../../go-build/monorepo-hash-darwin-x64 .
scripts.build:go:linux-arm64: mkdir -p go-build && cd src/go && GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o ../../go-build/monorepo-hash-linux-arm64 .
scripts.build:go:linux-arm64-musl: mkdir -p go-build && cd src/go && GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o ../../go-build/monorepo-hash-linux-arm64-musl .
scripts.build:go:linux-x64: mkdir -p go-build && cd src/go && GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o ../../go-build/monorepo-hash-linux-x64 .
scripts.build:go:linux-x64-musl: mkdir -p go-build && cd src/go && GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o ../../go-build/monorepo-hash-linux-x64-musl .
scripts.build:go:windows-arm64: mkdir -p go-build && cd src/go && GOOS=windows GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o ../../go-build/monorepo-hash-windows-arm64.exe .
scripts.build:go:windows-x64: mkdir -p go-build && cd src/go && GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o ../../go-build/monorepo-hash-windows-x64.exe .
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const installBinaryPath = path.join(__dirname, 'dist', 'install-binary.mjs'); if (fs.existsSync(installBinaryPath)) { const child_process = require('child_process'); child_process.execFileSync(process.execPath, [installBinaryPath], { stdio: 'inherit' }); }"
scripts.test: pnpm test:node && pnpm test:bun && pnpm test:go
scripts.test:bun: pnpm build:bun && pnpm test:bun:prepare && (vitest --project bun; code=$?; git restore src/bun/monorepo-hash.ts; exit $code)
scripts.test:bun:prepare: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='src/bun/monorepo-hash.ts';let t=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');t=t.replace(/\(async \(\) => {[\s\S]*?\/\/ #endregion[\r\n]*/g,'').replace(/exit\(\s*(\d+)\s*\)/g,(_,x)=>'if(![0,1].includes('+x+')){throw new Error(\"Exit with code '+x+'\")}');fs.writeFileSync(p,t);"
